description_full: Quantinuum Inc. manufactures and develops quantum computing hardware and software in United States and Internationally. The company develops a quantum computing platform that offers solutions, such as hardware platforms, developer tools, application libraries, and solution-targeted intellectual property. Its integrated quantum computing platform combines quantum hardware systems and middleware with application software designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. The company was founded in 2021 and is based in Broomfield, Colorado.

financial_summary: Quantinuum Inc. is a mid-cap technology business with a $9.5B market cap on $31M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +35% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at -39% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 58% confirm genuine pricing power.
The company is burning through $235M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.

Net dilution runs at 8.7% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 5.8% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
